fact: Instruction n°001-01-2024 of 23 January 2024 requires prior BCEAO licensing of payment institutions (applications filed with the national BCEAO office), with the Banking Commission as supervisor.
title: Instruction N°001-01-2024 relative aux services de paiement dans l'Union Monétaire Ouest Africaine
publisher: Banque Centrale des États de l'Afrique de l'Ouest (BCEAO)
